cards.basicText:
If a totem is in Thrall's range, choose 1:
- Draw 3 cards; keep 2 and discard 1 
- Discard 1 card; then search your deck for 1 card, add it to your hand, and shuffle your deck.
cards.title: Mana Tide Totem

cards.basicText: Choose a totem in Thrall's range. Deal 4 damage to all opposing fighters adjacent to the chosen totem. Destroy that totem.
cards.title: Fire nova totem

cards.duringText: If you destroyed a totem, prevent all damage.
cards.immediateText: Choose and destroy a totem in Thrall's range.
cards.title: Grounding totem

cards.afterText: If used to defend, the opposing player loses 1 action. If used to attack, gain 1 action.
cards.basicText: Requires a totem in Thrall's range to be played.
cards.title: earthbind totem

cards.basicText:
Destroy up to 4 totems, regardless of zone. Gain 1 HP for each totem destoryed. 

Search your deck or discard for a TOTEM.
cards.title: totemic recall

cards.afterText: You may place 1 totem in an eligible space in Thrall's zone. If you won the combat, deal 1 damage to the opposing fighter.
cards.title: Lightning bolt

cards.duringText: Deal 1 damage to an enemy fighter adjacent to the opposing fighter and 1 damage to an enemy fighter adjacent to that adjacent fighter.
cards.title: Chain Lightning

cards.afterText: You may place 1 totem in an eligible space in Thrall's zone. If you lost the combat, deal 1 damage to the opposing fighter.
cards.title: Lightning Shield
elemental guardian

cards.afterText: Move Thrall up to 3 spaces. You may move Thrall through spaces containing opposing fighters.
cards.title: Feral Wolf

cards.immediateText: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card.
cards.title: Earth Shock

cards.basicText: Add 1 to the value of the next attack card played this turn for each totem in Thrall's range. Gain 1 action.
cards.title: elemental mastery

cards.basicText: You may place totems on eligible spaces in Thrall’s zone until Thrall has 4 totems in play. While at 4, destroy 1 of your totems before placing each new one (repositioning). If you draw this card to start the game, reshuffle and draw again.
cards.title: Nature's Call

cards.afterText: If you won the combat, choose one of the fighters in the combat and move them up to 2 spaces.
cards.duringText: Destroy up to 4 totems in Thrall's range. Add 1 to the value of this card for each destroyed totem.
cards.title: Elemental fury

hero.name: Thrall
hero.specialAbility:
At end of turn, place 1 totem in any space unoccupied by opposing fighters and in Thrall's range (max 4 in play at any time). 
When an opposing fighter occupies a totem's space, destroy that totem.
hero.quote: An orc shaman who claims the battlefield one totem at a time, bending its spaces to his will and calling the spirits down on anyone who trespasses.

name: Thrall, son of Durotan
note: As a shaman, Thrall wields the power of the elements and channels them through totems. With proper totem placement, Thrall has many utilities available to deal damage and get out of situations. Yet enemies can bait you outside their range or destroy them easily.
